_anchor_note: null = no personal baseline. Games are then read against the reference registers in out/ladder.json rather than as multiples of a game. Set this to a slug only if you want multipliers and an inferred working-vocabulary figure.
_population_note: all-dialogue = main story, side content, companion and ambient lines. NOT item descriptions or documents (that is all-text). Comparing corpora collected under different populations is invalid, so `measure` refuses to build one table out of two.
_wiki_note: Hosts verified reachable via discover. Only rdr2 and re4-remake actually carry game dialogue: ghost-of-tsushima, demons-souls, god-of-war-2018 and kcd2 have no dialogue category at all, totk has one page, and the bg3 host is the whole series wiki whose Dialogues category is empty of BG3.
_shared_wiki_note: A wiki covering a whole series will hand back the wrong game's dialogue. Those entries carry shared_wiki: true and are REFUSED until game_filter or page_filter is set from what `discover` reports. game_filter selects category names; page_filter selects pages by their own categories, and by their parent page's for an `X/dialogues` subpage, which is the only thing that separates games filed in one flat category.
_load_note: The `load` fields cannot be derived from a transcript and must be filled in by hand or left null. Nothing downstream invents them: a null stays null in the output.

_source_note: Every corpus now comes from YouTube automatic captions of a no-commentary playthrough. Fandom could not supply this list: six of the eight wikis have no dialogue category, and the two that do gave 50k words for one game and 1.3k for another. The cost was measured by collecting rdr2 both ways — vocabulary coverage survives (+0.5%), syntax and archaism do not (-26%, -45%) — so caption corpora declare which axes they support and the report leaves the rest blank.
